description: This file defines the interface for RDK Window Manager within the WPEFramework exchange namespace. It includes the IRDKWindowManager interface with nested INotification interface, which declares several event callback methods related to application and window state changes, as well as control methods for managing windows, application focus, input interception, and other window management functions.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: Interface for the RDK Window Manager handling window and application state, input interception, and notification registration.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface defining callback methods for various window and application events such as focus, visibility, connection status, and activity notifications.
